1. Allowed, subject to all just exceptions.
2.
The application stands disposed of.

3. The present petition has been filed seeking quashing of FIR No. 507/2015 under Sections 498A/406/506 of the Indian Penal Code, 1860 (IPC) registered at Police Station Shahbad Dairy,
New Delhi, on the ground of settlement.
4. The petitioner no.1 is the husband of the respondent no.2 and the petitioners no.2 to 6 are family members of the petitioner no.1.
The marriage of the petitioner no.1 and the respondent no.2 was solemnized on 7th July, 2007 as per Hindu rites and ceremonies.
No child was born out of the wedlock.

sentences.text: 5. Disputes arose between the petitioners and the respondent no.2, which resulted in filing of the present FIR by the respondent no.2 against the petitioners.

6. Now, the parties have settled all their disputes before the Delhi Mediation Centre, Rohini Courts,
Delhi and the Settlement Agreement dated 3rd December, 2022 has been filed as Annexure-B to the present petition.
In terms of the settlement agreement the petitioner no.1 and the respondent no.2 are living together now.
7. Issue notice.

8. Notice is accepted by the learned APP appearing on behalf of the State and the respondent no.2,
who is present in person.
9.
The respondent no.2 is present in Court and has been identified by the Investigating Officer (IO).
She informs the Court that she has settled the matter of her own free will and without any coercion.
She further states that she has no objection to quashing of the FIR.
10. The petitioners are also present in Court and have been identified by their counsel.
They affirm the statement of the respondent no.2 and undertake to abide by the terms of settlement arrived at between the parties.

11. Considering the above settlement between the parties and the chances of conviction of the petitioner being remote and bleak, there is no use continuing with proceedings of the present FIR as it would be a misuse of the process of the Court and an unnecessary burden on the State exchequer.

Hence, it would be in the interest of justice to quash the aforementioned FIR and the proceedings pursuant thereto.
12.
Consequently, the FIR No. 507/2015 at Police Station Shahbad Dairy and the proceedings pursuant thereto are quashed.
This is a digitally signed order.
The authenticity of the order can be re-verified from Delhi High Court Order Portal by scanning the QR code shown above.
The Order is downloaded from the DHC Server on 20/12/2023 at 01:03:31 13.
The petition stands disposed of.
